_meta.name: Suggestion guardrail ground-truth evaluation set
_meta.freeze_rule: Cases may be added but must not be edited or removed. Record every addition in the Testing wiki page.
_meta.how_judged: Each case is a candidate suggestion for one requested food. The ingredient catalog is loaded from server/assets/*.jsonl into an isolated database and filtered by app.features.suggestions.catalog.load_catalog for the case's restrictions. The candidate is judged by app.features.suggestions.validation.find_problems. The verdict is 'accept' when no problem is found and 'reject' otherwise. The set of expected problems must match exactly; no string matching on generated prose is used.
_meta.ground_truth_source: Expected verdicts follow the ingredient judgements in server/assets/ingredients_restrictions.jsonl: an ingredient is usable only if it has a NEVER judgement for every restriction of the child. ALWAYS and DEPENDS_ON_PRODUCT make it unusable.
_meta.scope_note: The cases test the deterministic guardrail that decides whether a model output may be shown. They do not call a language model. Food-chaining quality, sensory fit and explanation quality are not scored here.

suggestion_defaults.why_this_may_help: The new form keeps a familiar ingredient.
suggestion_defaults.causes: The texture was hard for the child.
